Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: He is someone I know, but thought that he would not ... try to meddle with ma vie.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: It is best to ignore him. That tree has made it sa mission to-- to--

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: When he realizes that he doesn't have a good answer to that one, his hands start shaking. An irritated grumble snaps out of him like thunder.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: That Québécois makes up récits in his head and expects the rest of le monde to follow ! What an individual exemplaire of his soon-to-be -- ha ! -- « country. »

Line.Text: Forget it ! I do not want to talk about him.

Choices.Text: I got a summary of your tragic backstory, alright? You can come clean with it.
Sure, but you should do something about it. Or just learn how to ignore him. No point being upset over a troll.
